title: What's Next! with Tiffani Bova — 'The hardest part of growth is staying recognizable to the people who trusted you early'
summary: Tiffani Bova drops the audio release of her Eric conversation on the What's Next! Podcast — the follow-up to the 06-30 LinkedIn Live, now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify. Her closing frame: the real test of growth is whether a company can get bigger without becoming less worthy of trust.
blockquote:
The hardest part of growth is staying recognizable to the people who trusted you early.

A company can lose its way through choices that look sensible in isolation. Over time, those choices can teach the organization to protect short-term outcomes first and make the original mission easier to compromise.
attribution_title: Host, What's Next! Podcast; Chief Strategy & Research Officer, The Futurum Group; 2x WSJ bestselling author
